title: Run record
description: Immutable, append-only record of a single executed run (one batch / one experiment unit). PLAN §2 (Q2). Prose lives in `narrative_md`, authored by the agent, not the human. A run is stamped with the substrate versions it ran against (Q6) — that stamp is what powers automatic blast-radius. Once written, a run record is never edited; a re-run produces a NEW record with this one in `parents`.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema the instance was written against.

id.description: Run id = the experiment writeup's filename stem (1:1 with the .md, unique by construction). s + number + optional variant letter(s) + optional underscore-words. Short forms (s106) also validate. Stable forever; referenced by claims and goal nodes.

parents.description: Run ids this run descends from (re-run lineage, cascade stages). Forms the run DAG.

goal_node.description: Id of the goal node this run attaches to (PLAN §2 goal tree). Referential: must resolve to a goal_node. The goal = WHY the run was done; the pipeline (tests[]) = the METHOD it exercised (ADR-0005).

tests.description: pipeline ids this run exercises (Experiment -> tests -> Pipeline, ADR-0005). The reverse edge (pipeline tested_by run) is derived from this, not stored. Empty for runs not attached to a first-class method.

blocked_by.description: glossary_term ids of the named obstacle(s) that blocked this run (Experiment -> blocked-by -> Blocker, ADR-0005; the blocker is modelled as a glossary term, e.g. 'finite-diff-omega-aliasing'). Tagging runs across pipelines with a shared blocker surfaces 'this obstacle keeps killing different regimes' — the ADR-0005 payoff edge.

contract_ref.description: The frozen branch contract this run executed against, with the amendment version in force at run time. Null for cheap auto-runs / probes that need no contract (Q4).

amendment.description: Amendment version in force (e.g. 'v0' for the frozen original, 'v2' after two amendments).

question.description: The specific question this run answered.

hypothesis.description: The prediction under test before running.

status.description: Outcome of the run against ITS OWN (often local) hypothesis — NOT whether the research thread advanced. A run can be 'confirmed' while sitting inside a thread that later died (e.g. 'confirmed the bug exists', 'confirmed the cheap path is insufficient'). So aggregate counts of `confirmed` measure local-hypothesis hit-rate, NOT research progress, and do NOT correspond to the PLAN's rework / binding-constraint figure (53/100 dead experiments). Do not chart `confirmed` totals as a progress metric without re-deriving research-advanced/dead at the thread level.

run_type.description: Governs the contract gate (Q4) and the execution queue (Q5). probe = the ≤3-min off-contract carve-out; cheap = auto; expensive/batch = gated, serialised per the no-stacking rule.

N.description: Sample size backing this run's claim (usually len(seeds) but may differ).

claim_scope.description: Scope of claim this run can support. The N-scope gate auto-downgrades a 'cohort' tag with N below threshold to 'N1'.

metrics.description: Open metric bag. Common keys (units): q0_err [deg], w_dir_err [deg], w_mag_err [deg/s or %], w_mag [deg/s], rho [surrogate residual], rho_band [A|B|C|D], wall_s [s]. |ω| is ALWAYS in deg/s (working-preference claim). Add domain keys freely; the dashboard indexes whatever is present.

artefacts.description: Output files produced. Plots/anims surface to the web-app plot stream tagged by this run (PLAN §8 visual-validation).

caption.description: One-line caption for the plot stream.

writeup_refs.description: Paths to the original prose writeup(s) (the experiment .md). PLAN W-B: every backfilled record links back to its writeup for nuance.

commit.description: git SHA the run executed at (reproducibility).

substrate_versions.description: Map of substrate component id -> version in force at run time (e.g. {"propagator": "2.0.0", "surrogate": "v2", "scorer": "1.0.0"}). Keys must resolve to substrate_component ids. THIS is the blast-radius stamp: when a component bumps past a stamped version, this run (and claims that cite it) flip to needs_replication.

gates_passed.description: Trust-machine gates this run passed (PLAN §3). Epistemic gates dominate for runs; code-discipline gates apply at substrate promotion.

gates_failed.description: Gates this run knowingly did not pass (e.g. a diagnostic that intentionally reads oracle data fails 'oracle-leak'). Lets the calibration skill learn from honest non-blind runs.

oracle_clean.description: True iff no truth_* key was read during the run (oracle-leak gate). A diagnostic that seeds from an oracle-nearest pair is oracle_clean=false even when it succeeds — this is the s058/s059 disease made explicit.

created_at.description: When the record was written (ISO-8601). Set by the writer (close/run skill).

executed_at.description: When the compute actually ran, if different from created_at.

narrative_md.description: Agent-authored prose narrative (Q2). The human reads this; the structured fields drive the machine. Markdown.
